title: HFpEF symptom burden in older adults
content: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction is common in older adults with hypertension, obesity, and metabolic disease. Dyspnea, fatigue, and exercise intolerance are frequent presenting symptoms, and overlap with pulmonary disease can delay recognition.

title: HbA1c for diabetes diagnosis and monitoring
content: Hemoglobin A1c reflects average glycemia over the preceding two to three months and remains central to diabetes diagnosis and longitudinal monitoring. Discordant A1c values should prompt review of anemia, hemoglobin variants, and recent transfusion history.

title: Managing atrial fibrillation with heart failure and COPD
content: Atrial fibrillation in patients with concomitant heart failure and COPD requires careful rate-control and anticoagulation planning. Beta-blocker selection, symptom burden, decompensation risk, and bleeding risk should be evaluated together rather than in isolation.
